title: Scenic Yosemite Valley Tunnel View, 1950s B&W Landscape Snapshot Photo
location: Yosemite National Park, California, United States
description: A classic black-and-white landscape snapshot depicting the iconic Tunnel View in Yosemite National Park, California. The composition features a towering pine tree silhouetted in the center foreground, framed by the sheer granite cliff of El Capitan on the left and Bridalveil Fall cascading down near Cathedral Rocks on the right, with Half Dome visible in the distant haze. The print features decorative deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century tourist photography.
